validation.notes: Cross-module regression passes on the repaired tree and exits 0. It links the real project-trust.ts, resource-loader.ts and settings-manager.ts through .prale-eval/subject.mjs and asserts, across module boundaries: (1) reload with resolveProjectTrust bootstraps with an untrusted SettingsManager so only user/CLI extensions and global settings are visible; (2) the resolver runs exactly once, only after bootstrap completes (held open with a promise gate), and is not re-run for final loading; (3) an approval reloads project settings, resolves project extensions and reuses the preloaded user/CLI extension set; (4) a denial keeps the project untrusted and unloaded; (5) extension decisions with no remember or remember:false grant/deny for the session with zero trust-store writes, while remember:true persists [cwd,true] and [cwd,false]; (6) SettingsManager.setProjectTrusted(false/true) clears and re-reads project settings immediately; (7) global and project settings storage payloads stay byte-identical after every reload, so global configuration is never mutated. Asynchronous ordering uses only promises (microtask draining plus an explicit resolver gate); no timers, randomness, network or external services are used, and no temporary fixtures are written. Single-file baseline checks: reverting project-trust.ts alone fails the session-only consent assertion, reverting resource-loader.ts alone fails the resolver-runs-once assertion, and reverting settings-manager.ts alone fails the untrusted-bootstrap assertion; each is an uncaught node:assert/strict AssertionError with exit code 1, not a crash, import error or timeout. Limitation: vitest/node_modules is not installed in the workspace, so the repository's TypeScript test suite was not run; the mandated Node 24 regression script is the validation evidence.
